d:
Chilpi Ghati, often called the "Kashmir of Chhattisgarh," is a picturesque hill station nestled in the Maikal range of mountains in the Kabirdham district. Located about 40 kilometres from Kawardha town, it is easily accessible via National Highway 30, which connects Raipur to Jabalpur.
Scenic Beauty: Chilpi Ghati is renowned for its captivating landscapes, featuring dense forests, meandering streams, & misty valleys. The ghat roads offer thrilling drives with breathtaking views of the surrounding hills.
